findings.claim: The documentation still presents an 11-agent roster that does not exactly match the 14-role manifest roster required by the acceptance criteria.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion: `.agent-team/team.json` SHALL define exactly the roster in `docs/agent-team.md`; hunk `docs/agent-team.md` adds `## Roster` with eleven agents including `fhir-ideation-strategist` and `fhir-knowledge-curator`, while `.agent-team/team.config.json` roster has fourteen roles, excludes those two merged roles, and adds five domain roles.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the authoritative roster in `docs/agent-team.md` the 14-role manifest roster only, or rename/move the legacy 11-agent table so it is not the documented team roster used by the requirement.
